answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. What survives to the willow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The tundra holds work receipts rather than names, so the reef of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
